issue.title: Split AECP: SET_CONFIGURATION status and SET_STREAM_INFO 2013 body
issue.body:
Part of #665 (Mark II split flip). Found by the in-house replica on the test machine (#665 issuecomment-6904803181, findings 16 and 17). The release passed both on Oct 31.

1. **SET_CONFIGURATION with an out-of-range configuration_index answers BAD_ARGUMENTS** (`sw/firmware/ctrl/aecp/aecp_commands.c`, the SET_CONFIGURATION handler). IEEE 1722.1-2021 7.4.7.1: the index names a CONFIGURATION descriptor, so an index with no such descriptor answers NO_SUCH_DESCRIPTOR.
2. **SET_STREAM_INFO with the 48-byte IEEE 1722.1-2013 body answers BAD_ARGUMENTS.** The split requires the 84-byte body; the fabric protocol processor accepts the 48-byte body (its fields end at stream_vlan_id) since protocol-processor PR #183. A fabric qualification fix with no split counterpart, the class of the ledger in #665 issuecomment-6899740728 item 3.

**Acceptance.** Each fixed with a firmware unit test and a planted defect caught by name; the AECP campaign and the service-budget rows unchanged or within bound; on the bench, both scenarios pass.
